fields.description: Agents created by Frappe and protected from deletion.
fields.label: System Generated

fields.description: Flow Model used to drive this agent.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Maximum number of think → tool → think loops before the run gives up.
fields.label: Max Iterations

fields.description: Allow Flow to select this agent automatically for matching requests.
fields.label: Allow Auto Routing

fields.description: Short business domain used to shortlist this agent, for example Accounts Payable or Support.
fields.label: Routing Domain

fields.description: Tie-break priority. Higher values win only when candidates are otherwise equally suitable.
fields.label: Routing Priority

fields.description: Describe the requests this agent should receive. Keep operational instructions in Instructions.
fields.label: Routing Description

fields.description: JSON array of DocType names this agent is designed to work with.
fields.label: Routing DocTypes

fields.description: One representative user request per line.
fields.label: Routing Examples

fields.description: System message shown to the LLM. Describe the agent's role, scope, and rules.
fields.label: Instructions

fields.description: Flow Tools this agent can call, with an optional per-agent permission override. Defaults to the three primitives (describe, read, execute) on creation.
fields.label: Tools

fields.description: Knowledge bases this agent can search. Empty means all enabled knowledge bases.
fields.label: Knowledge Bases
